description:
About XBOW

XBOW is the autonomous offensive security company. The platform continuously tests applications, chains real attack paths, and proves exploitability with working evidence. Over 200 security teams, from Fortune 50 to high-growth software companies use XBOW to find exploitable vulnerabilities before attackers do.

Your Role

We are seeking a hands-on Product Marketing Lead to own XBOW's positioning and messaging, and to co-manage launches with product management. You work between product, marketing and revenue. You turn what the product does into words that CISOs, application security leaders and red team leaders believe, and that our sellers can use. You understand cybersecurity and our highly skeptical audience well. You are an advanced Claude user (or similar): you use it every day to track dozens of Slack channels, collect competitive intel inside and outside the company, and get your daily work done faster. You start as an individual contributor working alongside our product marketing manager, with the opportunity to lead and grow a lean, high-performing team in the future.

This role reports to our VP of Marketing.

 

What You’ll Do

  • Own positioning and messaging in close partnership with product, revenue and marketing. Keep both current as the product and the market evolve on a weekly basis.

  • Plan, run and report on product launches with product management, from the launch plan to sales readiness and the announcement.

  • Run competitive intelligence. Collect it internally from Slack deal channels, sales calls and the field. Collect it externally from competitor websites, releases, analysts and communities. Turn it into battle cards and talk tracks our sellers use.

  • Track dozens of Slack channels across product, engineering, sales and customer success daily. Catch what matters, like a new capability, a repeated objection or a customer win, and act on it.

  • Use Claude, internal LLM tools (and others) extensively for daily tasks: summarizing channels, collecting intel, drafting and checking your work. Keep the ideas and the voice human.

  • Partner closely with Sales on ICP and messaging. Build the decks, battle cards, objection answers and proof points sellers need, and update them as deals show what works.

  • Turn public proof, like the full-chain Chrome exploit Google paid $250,000 for, into messaging for technical buyers. Lead with customer results for non-technical buyers.

  • Hold every claim to its source. Use current, verified numbers, and cut any claim the product does not keep.

  • Work with Product, Engineering and Leadership so XBOW tells one story everywhere.

  • This role is fully remote, with occasional travel of up to 10% for events and team gatherings.

Who You Are

  • Product marketer with 5+ years of B2B cybersecurity product marketing experience, at least 2 of them in a senior role

  • A self starter who has 3+ years of experience at early stage startups (seed, series A to D)

  • Advanced Claude user (or similar). You use it daily to track Slack channels, collect competitive intel and draft your work, and you can show how

  • Pragmatic about tools. You know when LLMs help and when they create slop

  • Hands-on. You write the messaging, build the decks and run the launches yourself

  • Clear writer. You turn complex technical concepts into messaging that security and engineering audiences trust

  • Curious about both the technical side of offensive security and how buyers decide

  • Good at getting a clear answer out of product managers, researchers, engineers and sellers

  • Independent and able to deliver on goals with minimal oversight

  • Communicator who leads clearly and with empathy

  • Doer who gets things done through grit and good organization

  • Comfortable with ambiguity. You adapt as a high-growth product and team change

  • Comfortable giving and receiving critical feedback

  • Focused and thoughtfully responsive to interruptions based on priorities

Bonus If You Have

  • Experience marketing offensive security, penetration testing, or AI-powered security products to technical buyers and security practitioners

  • Technical background in offensive security, application security or penetration testing

  • Previous experience at a venture-backed startup during a period of rapid scaling or a Series C to Series E growth phase

  • Examples: links to 2-3 launches, messaging pieces or competitive assets you're proud of, as part of the screening process

     

What We Offer

  • Compensation & Equity: Competitive salary, clear performance-based incentives, and equity package, making you an integral part of XBOW’s growth story.

  • Career Growth: Significant opportunities to progress within the marketing organization and shape your career trajectory as we scale.

  • Meaningful Work: You’ll directly impact XBOW’s mission to revolutionize cybersecurity and protect organizations worldwide.

What Else You Should Know

  • Location: US Remote

  • Contract: Full-time

  • Hiring Process:

    • Introduction with Talent

    • Hiring Team Interview

    • Role Related Interviews

    • Final Interview

At XBOW, we leverage AI every day, it's embedded in our product and our go-to-market approach. But for this role, we’re seeking someone who brings genuine curiosity, empathy, and persistence. If that's you, we'd love to connect.
